ordinance_area_text: (5) Hunting and firearms. No person in a park shall hunt, trap or pursue wildlife. Trapping may be authorized, by permit, when it is deemed by the director that said activity is in the best interest of public health, safety and/or welfare. No person shall within a park use, brandish or discharge any firearm, air rifle, spring gun, pellet gun, paintball gun, bow and arrow, sling or any other form of weapon potentially dangerous to wildlife or to human safety or any instrument that can be loaded with and fire blank cartridges. Shooting into park areas from beyond park property boundaries is forbidden.
method: Roanoke County open-data 'Park Site Areas' (Park_Site_Areas_Hosted, a regional managed-areas layer). Selected features where OWNER or MAAGENCY starts with 'Roanoke County' (incl. VRFA-owned Explore Park and Mayflower Hills, which county parks operates). Dropped MATYPE 'Reservoir' (Carvins Cove is City of Roanoke) and MATYPE 'School' features unless the label names a park. Added 2 DCR Conservation Lands polygons (Hinchee Park; 2nd Jae Valley Park tract) that are missing from the county layer. Clipped to Census cb_2023 Roanoke County boundary (drops county-owned Arnold R. Burton Complex in Salem and slivers in Salem/Botetourt). Dissolved by name.
notes: 43 parks. Camp Roanoke and Spring Hollow share one identical polygon in the source, so they are merged as 'Camp Roanoke / Spring Hollow'. That polygon (~600 ac) may include Western Virginia Water Authority reservoir land rather than only county park land. Hinchee Park comes from DCR only. School-ground recreation sites (e.g. Cave Spring MS, Northside HS tennis courts) are excluded, but Sec. 13-5.3 already bars hunting within 100 yd of schools and parks; that buffer is not modeled. Parks inside the Town of Vinton are included because county ordinances apply in towns. The app's coarse jurisdiction outline differs from the Census boundary, so a few parks may plot slightly outside it.
recovered: Recovered 2026-11 from public/data/local-areas.geojson (the original source files were lost); geometry carries that layer's 30% simplification.
